The '''Coral Coast''' of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] was the shorelines that spread out southeast of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]].

==Description==
Known as the Coral Coast to residents and visitors alike, the shoreline was dotted by debris washed up from millennia of a lack of environmental protections placed on industry. Scavenger communities from the Breakwater sailed across Worlport Bay to reach the coastlines and salvage any useful junk.<ref name="MPQ" />
